items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: that's where I first met him down there

ctx.x: : That's amazing. Okay now, let's go back to these piano players now. Before we get to the great ones, what about Edgar Hays? Remember Edgar Hays?
Oh, Edgar! Edgar was a very good pianist. He had a band, you know, and he went up to the -- he was up at the Cotton Club I think for awhile, with somebody.
And then he -- I remember him down at 126th Street Theatre there down on 7th Avenue, and that's where I first met him down there -- and then he went to, after awhile, he went to California.
